title: Hodge Laplacian on $1$-forms of homogeneous $3$-spheres
summary: We study the spectrum of the Hodge-Laplacian on $1$-forms for left-invariant metrics on the Lie group $\operatorname{SU}(2) \cong S^3$ and its quotient $\operatorname{SO}(3)\cong P^3(\mathbb{R})$. To the best of our knowledge, we provide the first explicit computation of the full spectrum of the Hodge-Laplacian for a canonical variation by determining the eigenvalues of Berger 3-spheres and analyzing their resulting splitting behavior.
